notes.title: ERRORS AND LOCALIZATION
notes.content: Friends, if something in the game doesn't work, try clicking the "download" button in the menu . This will help you restart the algorithms and fix the problem . Write about any bugs that occur . I'm working on a game. And I apologize in advance for the localization as I am not a polyglot and use Google translate. Native speakers can contact me I will send them the English version of the localization for an adequate translation and add your version
